experiments.mechanism: At-least-two-table inclusion and regularized correction; finite estimator bias and input-domain characterization.

conditions.execution: portable selected scalar body, no Torch/CUDA/model dependencies
conditions.seed: fixed literal deterministic fixture, no RNG
conditions.oracle: Exhaustive independent bit/table outcomes and FP64 binomial mass; finite estimator expectations.
conditions.estimator_model: 64 exhaustive outcomes for two synthetic independent candidate table-hit processes; conditional on nonempty set, not shared geometric LSH hyperplanes
conditions.invalid_domains: Existing NaN/Inf or acceptance characterized using valid bounded arrays; no out-of-range index accesses

experiments.note: Support: supplied logits only, not end-to-end unbiased self-normalized attention. Invalid domains characterize existing defects with valid buffers.
